summary: Tested the new wide Pulse Fitness logo in three places: (1) service report PDFs built by pulse_header, (2) fire station certificate PDFs built by blue_light_certificate_pdf, including the 3 already-stored certificates that were rebuilt at startup, and (3) the Service Desk PPM 'Print report' HTML popup in PpmScheduleDetail.js. Every check passed and nothing regressed. 10/10 backend tests passed (5 new, 5 regression).

issues: Already there before this change: the header says 'Part of The Pulse Group' but the footer says 'A pulseglobal Company'. The group name doesn't match (cosmetic).
Calendar items for the next month took about 3s or more to appear after clicking ppm-next-month. The API is fast, so the UI fetch or render is slow. Minor.

verified_passing: Asset backend/assets/pulse-logo-wide.jpg is 1193x216. pulse-logo-wide-light.png is RGBA with a transparent wide image. GET {BASE_URL}/brand/pulse-logo-wide.jpg returns 200 and a JPEG of the same byte size
pulse_header default renders the 1193x216 image at about 155.9pt (55mm) wide with the aspect ratio kept and no 'Pulse Fitness' text

Live GET /api/svc/cases/{id}/service-report.pdf (owner@isodemo.com) for 3 closed/completed cases: the page-1 image is the wide logo (1193x216) and there is no wordmark in the header. Visually checked: the logo sits on the left and the contact block on the right

Fire certificates: all 3 stored crm2_certificates (2 sent, 1 awaiting_review) have rebrand_tag 'pulse-logo-wide-2026-06', and their stored PDFs contain the light wide logo image. Visually checked: white 'pulsefitness' with the cyan ring on the dark banner and 'Qualified to deliver the best' on the right. Status was unchanged

Service Desk > Maintenance > QA Fire Station (20 Nov 2026) > ppm-detail-print opens a popup. The src is {origin}/brand/pulse-logo-wide.jpg, it loads (naturalWidth 1193) and displays at 221x40. There is no .wm wordmark span and no reference to the old iscy9t7o badge. The header-left text is empty (logo only)
Regression: test_jan2026_pdf_header_logo_only.py 5/5 pass (tenant-branded header still shows the company name, and the other PDF generators import fine)

critical_code_review_comments: PpmScheduleDetail builds the logo src from window.location.origin. That works for the popup, but a printed or saved HTML copy needs the frontend host to be reachable. This is acceptable
_wide_logo_flowable opens the image with PIL on every header build. That's cheap, but the size could be cached at module level
